public.title: Find All Anagrams in a String
public.description: Return ascending start indices where a substring of text is a permutation of pattern. Both strings contain lowercase ASCII letters, text has at most 1000 characters, and pattern has 1 to 100 characters.
hints: Maintain letter counts in a fixed-size sliding window.
public.attribution: Original Bekor statement, examples, tests and solutions, 2026. Adapted from a standard algorithmic problem; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: Add the next letter and remove the expired letter. Equal 26-element count vectors identify anagrams. O(text length) time.
